prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: horizontal editorial cover photograph for a Spanish publication about AI and work
Primary request: a mountain rescue volunteer offering a hand to help a tired hiker over a rocky trail, a human scene about advice, trust and consequences.
Scene/backdrop: rugged European hillside path at blue hour with scrub and distant mountains, no signage.
Style/medium: candid outdoor photojournalism, respectful and unposed, detailed weathered gear, subtle 35mm film grain.
Composition/framing: cinematic 16:9 landscape, rescuer and hiker in clear human interaction, trail leading into the background.
Lighting/mood: fading daylight with one restrained red accent on a rescue jacket, serious but reassuring.
Color palette: warm near-black shadows, muted earth and stone, small red jacket detail.
Constraints: no text, logos, watermark, safe realistic posture.
Avoid: phones, screens, office, documents, robots, disaster spectacle, staged stock photography.
